draw: census: all 95 witnesses of census.json, in order
transcript: Canonical serialization rule: take the proposal artifact exactly as given, serialize it as JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace, persist the exact bytes hashed as proposal_canon.json in the run scratch dir, then compute hProposal = SHA-256(proposal_canon.json); the seed is derived as seedHex = SHA-256(hProposal + salt) (salt as provided by the engine), and a third party can re-derive by hashing the same proposal_canon.json bytes to reproduce hProposal and then hashing hProposal concatenated with the same salt to reproduce seedHex; witness draw rule is deterministic census: use every entry of census.json (all 95) in order.
